title: A father's debt must be paid by his son
next_chapter_hook: In the Void Rift, Chen Tianming's final remnant shadow gradually solidified. In those eyes, identical to Chen Ji's, lay ten thousand years of guilt and anticipation.

text.content:
Golden light like a blade, slicing through scenes of the ancient era frame by frame. Chen Ji felt his soul being torn into countless fragments, each carrying memories not his own—the supreme glory of ruling the Celestial Realm, the excruciating pain of being dismembered, the despair of countless rebirths through ten thousand worlds.

His body trembled, blood seeping from his seven orifices, yet he gritted his teeth and refused to fall unconscious. Because he saw the existence that had dismembered him—it was no physical entity, but an indescribable Heavenly Dao Will, a rule that stood above all.

At the moment consciousness was about to collapse, a gentle yet aged voice drifted from the void: "Ji'er, hold on."

Chen Ji forcefully opened his eyes, tears and blood blurring his vision. The golden light screen before him slowly cracked open, as if torn apart with the last ounce of strength. Through the gap, a hazy white-haired figure quietly gazed at him.

That face, seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's, yet aged a thousandfold, ten thousandfold.

dialogue.content:
Father... father?

Chen Ji spoke hoarsely, a sweetness rising in his throat. This was the first time in his memory that he had been so undisguised in asking someone. Since childhood, he had grown accustomed to never revealing his emotions, to hiding all feelings beneath that calm, unruffled face.

But now, facing this illusory figure, his layered masks were crumbling bit by bit.

Chen Tianming's remnant shadow gently smiled, a smile carrying too many emotions Chen Ji couldn't comprehend—guilt, heartache, relief, and bone-deep exhaustion.

"It is me." His voice was like a dying candle in the wind,，随时可能熄灭，"Ji'er, your father对不起你."

Chen Ji said nothing, simply watching him quietly. This was a habit he had developed over the years—when information was insufficient, never readily express an opinion. But his fists were already clenched, fingernails deeply embedded in his palms.

text.content:
In the Void Rift, Chen Tianming's remnant shadow drifted closer, his form even more illusory than before, as if about to scatter in the wind at any moment.

"The scenes you witnessed are all true." Chen Tianming's voice was low and deliberate, "You are the reincarnation of the Ancient Celestial Emperor, a wisp of divine soul that survived after being erased by the Heavenly Dao's Eye. Ten thousand worlds of reincarnation, our father-son reunion—all for this day."

Chen Ji remained silent, his eyes growing increasingly cold.

dialogue.content:
Chen Tianming looked at his son's gradually hardening face, a trace of bitterness flickering in his eyes.

"I know what you're thinking." He said softly, "You're wondering why me? Why drag me into this ten-thousand-year chess game? Why make me endure all this?"

He paused, his voice trembling: "Because... you are the only one who can break this."

Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice cold as ice: "Break what?"

text.content:
Chen Tianming's remnant shadow turned away, gazing into the depths of the endless void, as if he could see through time and space to that terrifying existence called the "Heavenly Dao's Eye."

"The Heavenly Dao's Eye is not as simple as you imagine." His voice grew heavy, "It is not a specific life form, but a transcendent consciousness—the fundamental rule by which this world operates. It permits no existence to threaten its authority, so it dismembered you, sealed your memories, and cast you into ten thousand worlds of reincarnation."

Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, but he did not interrupt.

dialogue.content:
And your true mission—"

Chen Tianming abruptly turned around, staring directly into Chen Ji's eyes, those eyes burning with an almost mad light.

"Is to destroy yourself."

These words struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. His body froze, cracks finally appearing on his composed face—disbelief, rage, and a bone-deep sorrow.

"What did you say?" His voice was low, yet carried uncontrollable trembling.

text.content:
Chen Tianming did not evade his son's gaze, but met it head-on.

"The Ancient Celestial Emperor was the only existence capable of opposing the Heavenly Dao's Eye. Your very existence is a threat to it. Through ten thousand worlds of reincarnation, your soul has been weakened again and again, yet it could never be completely erased—because your essence transcends rules."

His voice grew more urgent: "But as long as you exist, the Heavenly Dao's Eye will never stop hunting. Those you care about, everything you protect, will become its targets. The only way to break this—"

"Is to make me disappear completely." Chen Ji coldly finished, his voice devoid of any emotion.

dialogue.content:
Chen Tianming's form trembled violently, as if pierced by his son's coldness.

"Not disappear, but transcend." His voice choked, "Ji'er, you don't understand. The Heavenly Dao's Eye cannot be destroyed because it coexists with this world. As long as you willingly merge your Celestial Emperor's body into the Heavenly Dao, you can detonate a mark at its core—"

"Making it disperse with you."

Chen Ji's eyes at this moment turned completely cold, cold as ten-thousand-year-old ice: "So this is the purpose of your ten-thousand-year scheme? To send me to my death?"

text.content:
Dead silence filled the Void Rift.

Chen Tianming gazed at his son's cold face, then suddenly smiled. That smile contained too many complex emotions—a father's apology to his son, a chess master's regret toward his piece, and a mortal's helplessness and heroic tragedy in the face of fate.

"Ji'er, do you know?" His voice suddenly became very light, light as a falling leaf, "From the moment I found you, I have been asking myself—if one day I let you know the truth, what would you do?"

Chen Ji did not answer.

"I thought for ten thousand years," Chen Tianming continued, "thought of ten thousand possibilities. But I never imagined you would face it this way."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's eyes slightly shifted, and the corner of his lips suddenly curved into a derisive arc.

"Did you think I would cry? Beg you to spare me? Or angrily demand why you're so ruthless?"

He laughed softly, that laughter echoing in the vast void, carrying an indefinableironic意味.

"Father, you truly underestimate me."

He raised his head, staring directly into Chen Tianming's eyes—those eyes held no anger, no resentment, only a chilling calm: "I was only thinking—if I agree to you, what about my friends? Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and... Nian'er. You ask me to die, then who will you hand her over to?"

text.content:
Chen Tianming's remnant shadow slightly trembled.

"Did you think I hadn't considered this?" His voice suddenly became agitated, "Do you think all I've been doing for ten thousand years is playing chess? Chen Nian—my granddaughter—is the key!"

He took out a crystal-clear Jade Slip from his chest, extending it toward Chen Ji.

"This is the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key Unsealing Talisman' I refined with my life's essence. After the Holy Sect took Nian'er, they used her as a container to lock your fate. As long as you give her this talisman, she will no longer be a Heavenly Fate Lock Key, but the key to breaking fate!"

Chen Ji gazed at that Jade Slip, a complex light flickering in his eyes.

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming used his remaining will to open the final path for Chen Ji: breaking the cycle and transcending fate. Chen Ji faces the ultimate choice—to accept his father's dying wish or to defy the agreement.

choices.description: Accept his father's arrangement, voluntarily merge his Celestial Emperor's body into the Heavenly Dao, and detonate the mark at the core of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.
choices.visible_reward: Completely destroy the Heavenly Dao's Eye, bringing the ten-thousand-world reincarnation to a close

text.content:
Chen Ji reached out and took the Jade Slip. His fingers slightly trembled the moment they touched the slip, then returned to stillness.

"Alright." He said, his voice soft yet carrying a resolve.

Chen Tianming's eyes instantly moistened. Ten thousand years of scheming, ten thousand years of waiting—finally, at this moment, he glimpsed the dawn.

choices.description: Refuse his father's arrangement, choose to oppose fate in his own way, even if the cost is mutual destruction with the Heavenly Dao's Eye.
choices.visible_reward: Carve out a brand new path, preserving one's self-awareness
choices.risk_hint: Defying the Heavenly Dao may invite even greater backlash

text.content:
Chen Ji did not take the Jade Slip. Instead, he stepped back, his expression turning cold and mocking.

"Father, you think so beautifully." he said softly, "Let me die, so you can close your eyes peacefully? Sorry, I can't do that."

Chen Tianming's face instantly turned pale.

choices.description: Neither completely obedient nor completely rebellious, but finding a path that allows everyone to survive.
choices.visible_reward: Protect everyone, including himself and Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The third path may not exist at all

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then slowly raised his head, a hint of cunning flickering in his eyes.

"Father, you said the Eye of Heavenly Dao is a transcendent consciousness, coexisting with heaven and earth." His voice was calm and composed, "So, what if I could find a way to make it believe I am no longer a threat?"

Chen Tianming was stunned.

"You only gave me two choices—obey or rebel." Chen Ji laughed softly, "But you seem to have forgotten one thing—I am Chen Ji who never fails in calculation, not your puppet on a string."

choices.memory_label: 提出了第三条路的可能

text.content:
Chen Tianming gazed at his son's composed face, suddenly feeling a sense of estrangement.

For ten thousand years, he thought he knew this child well enough—a young man struggling to survive in adversity, atrash forced to hide his brilliance. But the Chen Ji standing before him now was like someone he no longer recognized at all.

There was no resentment in those eyes, no anger—only a chilling calmness and calculation that sent shivers down one's spine.

"What do you intend to do?" he asked, his voice trembling—not from fear, but from anticipation.

Chen Ji did not answer. Instead, he took out the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest. The fragment glowed faintly in his palm, as if sensing its master's will.

dialogue.content:
Chen Tianming's remnant shadow abruptly drifted forward, a flash of horror in his eyes.

"You want to use the Tianji Record?!" His voice turned sharp, "Impossible! Your Heavenly Fate Value is insufficient to support you in peering into the future! If you force it—"

"I know." Chen Ji interrupted him calmly, "Every use consumes five points of Heavenly Fate. And right now, I only have thirty points left."

He raised his head, staring directly into his father's worried eyes, a faint smile curling at the corner of his lips: "So, I will only look once."

"Look at what?"

"The third path."

text.content:
Chen Ji pressed the Tianji Record Fragment against his forehead. Golden light burst forth from his Brow Center, illuminating the entire time-space rift.

He saw—

At a certain point three hours into the future, Chen Nian held the Unsealing Talisman, standing atop a massive altar. Behind her was the main body of the Eye of Heavenly Dao—a colossal eye covering the entire sky, pouring destructive force upon her.

And Chen Ji himself stood before her, using his body to shield her from that annihilating light.

The image blurred for an instant, then cleared again. He saw his own fallen body, saw the desperate tears on Chen Nian's face, and also saw—that massive eye suddenly contracting at some point.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, his face pale as paper. The Tianji Record Fragment slipped from his hand, drifting gently to the ground.

"Ji'er!" Chen Tianming exclaimed in alarm, reaching out to support his son, only to pass through that illusory form.

Chen Ji waved his hand, stopping his father's approach. He took a deep breath, suppressing the metallic taste of blood rising in his throat, yet his expression became unusually calm.

"I saw it." he said, his voice somewhat hoarse, "I saw a path."

He raised his head, looking into his father's expectant eyes, and spoke word by word: "Not the two paths you gave me—a third path."

text.content:
In the time-space rift, Chen Tianming's remnant shadow stared blankly at his son.

He saw the blood threads seeping from his son's forehead, the marks where his fingernails had dug into his clenched fists, and the stubborn gleam in his eyes.

Ten thousand years.

He had waited for this moment for ten thousand years.

"Tell me." he said softly, his voice carrying a sense of release, "Let this father hear what your third path is."

Chen Ji took a deep breath and began to recount everything he had witnessed in the Tianji Record.

Chen Tianming listened to his son's account and fell silent for a long while.

Only the sounds of two people breathing remained in the time-space rift—one strong, one weak; one solid, one illusory.

"Are you certain you want to do this?" Chen Tianming finally spoke, his voice carrying complex emotions, "This path... is far more dangerous than choosing to obey or rebel."

Chen Ji did not speak, merely gazing quietly at his father.

"If you fail," Chen Tianming's voice grew lower, "you will lose everything—including your soul. There will be no reincarnation, no rebirth. You will utterly dissipate between heaven and earth."

Chen Ji remained silent, but in those eyes, a terrifying light was burning.

After a long while, Chen Ji finally spoke.

"Father." His voice was soft, yet carried an unshakeable firmness, "You schemed for ten thousand years, calculating everything to perfection. Yet you overlooked one thing."

"What?"

"I am not your chess piece."

Chen Tianming's body went rigid.

"You treat the world as a chessboard, everyone as chess pieces, fate as an enemy." Chen Ji's voice turned cold, "But you seem to have forgotten one thing—a true chess master is never a piece."

He stepped forward, staring directly into his father's complex gaze: "You gave me choices because you thought I would be like a chess piece, allowing you to pull my strings. But you were wrong. I am not a chess piece—I am the one who will overturn the chessboard."

Chen Tianming's remnant shadow completely stilled at this moment.

Gazing at his son's stern face, he suddenly smiled. That smile held bitterness, release, and an indescribable sense of pride.

"Good." he said, his voice carrying a tremor, "Good! Well said, overturning the chessboard!"

His figure began to fade more and more, as if about to dissipate in the wind at any moment.

"Ji'er, the last thing this father can do for you is pour all remaining will into this Unsealing Talisman." He took out the Jade Slip from his chest and solemnly extended it toward Chen Ji, "When you need it, it will give you unexpected power."

Chen Ji took the Jade Slip, sensing the磅礴 might contained within it.

Before Chen Tianming's remnant shadow completely vanished, he cast one final glance at his son.

That gaze held no scheming, no stratagems—only a father's deepest love for his child.

"Ji'er." His voice became very soft, as light as a breeze, "This father... is proud of you."

As the words fell, his form completely scattered within the time-space rift.

Chen Ji stood there, quietly gazing at the place where his father had vanished. After a long moment, he slowly knelt down, bowing three times deeply toward that emptiness.

"Father." His voice was somewhat hoarse, "Your debts, I will repay. But the way I repay them—I will decide for myself."

He rose to his feet, gripping the Jade Slip in his hand, his eyes burning with unprecedented determination.

The time-space rift slowly closed, golden light fading away piece by piece.

Chen Ji returned to reality. He found himself standing on the Rear Mountain of the Tianqing Sect, surrounded by familiar pine forests and clouds.

In his hand, the Unsealing Talisman glowed faintly, as if responding to his heart. And not far away, a figure was rapidly approaching—it was Su Qingyao, her face pale, anxiety evident in her eyes.

"Chen Ji!" She swept to his side, grabbing his shoulder, "What's wrong with you? I sensed your Heavenly Fate Value dropping sharply! You—"

Her words suddenly stopped, because she saw in Chen Ji's eyes a tenderness and resolve she had never witnessed before.

"I'm fine." Chen Ji said softly, a faint smile curling at the corner of his lips, "I just... finally understood some things."

He raised his head, gazing toward the distant horizon, where an invisible eye seemed to be watching him.

"Bring it on." he murmured, "Whoever you are, whatever you want—this game, I accept."
